headline: Maresca says Manchester City titles not tainted; Liverpool’s Isak and Gakpo injured – as it happened
body: Enzo Maresca faced the media for the first time since Manchester City were found guilty by the Premier League of over 100 financial rule breaches Football Weekly: You can watch/listen to the pod squad discuss Sunday’s clash between Liverpool and Manchester City, plus much more, in the latest episode. A reminder that Enzo Maresca will face the media in 20 minutes’ time at the Etihad Campus in Manchester. You can follow the press conference live here. Continue reading...
